name: IC Post Launcher
author: Inbound Creative

sections.description:
IC Post Launcher turns WordPress into a hands-off publishing machine. Instead of manually setting dates on every post, you define your publishing rhythm once — what time posts go live, how many per day, how many days apart — and IC Post Launcher queues everything into the next open slot automatically.

Built by Inbound Creative, makers of agentic AI software and WordPress plugins, and a full-service web marketing agency. Made for content teams that batch-write and drip-publish.

⚡ Auto-Queue

  • Set a default publish time, spacing (daily / every X days / weekly), and posts-per-day limit
  • Auto-schedule posts when they’re marked Pending Review, or every new draft
  • A queue start date lets your whole schedule begin on any day, month, and year you choose
  • Bulk action: select any drafts and Add to Schedule Queue in one click

🎯 Per-Post Control

Every post gets a IC Post Launcher box in the editor with four modes:

  • Auto — drop into the next open slot at your default time
  • Custom date & time — pick the exact minute, day, month, and year for that post
  • Off — protect a post from ever being auto-scheduled
  • Default — follow your global settings

A IC Post Launcher column on the Posts list shows every post’s mode at a glance, with Enable/Disable bulk actions.

🚀 One-Click Publish

  • Publish Today’s Posts button in the admin bar (with a live count)
  • Publish Entire Queue button in settings
  • Publish Now bulk action to fire specific posts instantly
  • Dashboard widget showing your upcoming queue

🛠 Fine-Tune Anything

The settings page lists every queued post with an inline date/time picker — retime any post to any minute, day, month, or year without opening it.

⭐ IC Post Launcher Pro

Need more for a content team or client sites? IC Post Launcher Pro adds:

  • Category Release Campaigns — release a set number of posts from a category by a deadline, oldest-first or newest-first
  • Activity Log — a complete audit trail of who created, edited, scheduled, or published every post, and how
  • Launch Calendar — a monthly timeline of everything going live, plus an upcoming-months overview
  • Publish date control — keep planned dates or stamp the actual publish time
  • Mass Post Deletion — bulk-remove posts by category or date & time range, with preview and trash/permanent options

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/post-launcher/, or install through Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings → IC Post Launcher to set your publish time, spacing, and triggers.
  4. Optional but recommended for low-traffic sites: set up a real server cron job hitting wp-cron.php every 5 minutes so scheduled posts fire exactly on time.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. The IC Post Launcher box appears in both the block editor and the classic editor.

What happens if a scheduled time has already passed?

The post is published immediately instead of getting stuck in “Missed Schedule.”

Can I stop one specific post from being auto-scheduled?

Yes — set that post’s IC Post Launcher mode to Off. It will be skipped by all auto-queue triggers.

Does it support custom post types?

Version 2.0 supports the standard post type. Custom post type support is on the roadmap.

Why aren’t my scheduled posts publishing on time?

WordPress relies on WP-Cron, which only runs when your site gets a visit. On low-traffic sites, add a real server cron job that requests wp-cron.php every few minutes.

Fully internationalized.
